description: This file defines the PackageManager class, which manages the installation, uninstallation, download, and interaction with package repositories in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for handling package metadata, verifying manifests, processing upgrades, and interfacing with external storage and repository systems.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing package installation, uninstallation, updates, and interaction with remote repositories in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: initializeComm
methods.description: Initializes communication with the external package repository.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Retrieves promotion details from the package repository.

methods.name: getModuleLoaderCategoryPackages
methods.description: Fetches categories of packages suitable for the module loader based on the specified category.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Obtains category packages and their releases from the repository based on category ID and filters.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches list of categories from the repository.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves list of packages within a category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Fetches releases for a specific package.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specific package release from the repository.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials with the repository.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials for repository access.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves stored user credentials.

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Retrieves terms and conditions from the repository.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available updates to installed packages.

methods.name: toNameValueList
methods.description: Converts an associative array into a name-value list format.

methods.name: toNameValueLists
methods.description: Converts multiple arrays into a list of name-value lists.

methods.name: fromNameValueList
methods.description: Converts a name-value list back into an associative array.

methods.name: buildInstalledReleases
methods.description: Builds a list of installed module releases for reporting.

methods.name: buildPackageXML
methods.description: Generates an XML representation of a package and its releases.

methods.name: addToCleanup
methods.description: Adds temporary directories to cleanup list for deletion on shutdown.

methods.name: cleanUpTempDir
methods.description: Removes temporary directories created during upgrade processes.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a specific file from a ZIP archive to a temporary directory.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest.php file from an upgrade ZIP archive.

methods.name: validateManifestType
methods.description: Validates the type specified in a package manifest.

methods.name: validateManifestVersion
methods.description: Validates the acceptable versions specified in the manifest.

methods.name: validate_manifest
methods.description: Performs overall validation of a package manifest.

methods.name: getInstallType
methods.description: Determines the type of install package based on directory structure.

methods.name: performSetup
methods.description: Performs initial setup and validation for package installation.

methods.name: unlinkTempFiles
methods.description: Removes temporary files used during upload or upgrade process.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Performs the installation of a package from a ZIP file.

methods.name: performUninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package based on its name.

methods.name: getUITextForType
methods.description: Returns user interface text for different package types.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns icon image URLs corresponding to package types.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Returns a list of package files staged for upgrade or installation.

methods.name: getLicenseFromFile
methods.description: Extracts license text from a license file inside a package.

methods.name: getInstalled
methods.description: Retrieves list of installed modules/packages based on type.

methods.name: getinstalledPackages
methods.description: Returns a list of installed packages with detailed info for display.
